basis.frame: the incumbent head-to-head common set, unchanged
basis.vintage_note: per-source precision is estimable for board years 2023-2026 only, and MIN_LAG_YEARS=3 keeps the scored window at 2014-2024, so the baseline is DEFINED using an estimate computed partly on the rows it scores. Legitimate for a baseline definition, which is not a prediction; NOT quotable as an out-of-sample result. This handicaps eFV, not the baseline, and the write-up must say so wherever the number appears.
basis.baseball_america_role: identifying third instrument only. It is not a term in the baseline: two sources give three second moments against four unknowns, so b and sigma are unidentified without it. Adding BA to SCORED_SOURCES would collapse the common set 4,284 -> 295 and is not done here.

incumbent_as_registered_2026_08_08.why_stale: the cluster count is unchanged, so the eFV matrix pool did not move; what grew is the common-set rows those same players own, from this program's Baseball America backfill and identity repairs

incumbent_rederived_today.note: AMENDMENT 1. Same frame, same B, same seeds as every challenger arm in this artifact. This is the number the site's head-to-head claim actually rests on today, and it supersedes the row above.

C2_random_admissible_weights.interpretation: if a majority of arbitrary admissible reweightings already beat the served consensus, the finding is a defect report against consensus.py's construction, not evidence that precision weighting works

pooled_vs_within_year.reading: if the pooled rho materially exceeds the mean within-year rho, the statistic is partly ranking cohorts against each other, and any per-year centering of a baseline deletes exactly that part

consensus_input_breadth.reading: the denoised arms combine FanGraphs and Pipeline only. Every row above two sources is information the served consensus has and the baseline does not, which is a confound in the served consensus's favour and must be stated wherever this control is quoted

two_source_rows_only.reading: restricted to rows where the served consensus had at most the same two sources the baseline uses, so construction is compared without the information gap

primary_as_registered.verdict_why: the denoised construction is not a better aggregate on this frame, so it says nothing about eFV's margin

primary_corrected_amendment_2.why: the registered primary centers each source inside its board year, a transform the incumbent baseline does not have, so it is not like-for-like. S3 is the same GLS precision weights with a global per-source intercept. The correction moves the verdict AGAINST eFV, which is why it is a correction and not spec-shopping.
primary_corrected_amendment_2.verdict_why: the E_cond win the site rests on does not survive a precision-weighted baseline

attribution.why: if the head-to-head win is gone, the site needs to know how much of that is this control and how much was already true. Attributing the whole move to denoising would overstate what B-L6 found; attributing none of it would bury a live defect in the served claim.
attribution.reading: frame drift is the BA backfill and the identity repairs landing in the common set; denoising is this lane. They are separate findings and must be reported separately.
